sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) > 0), "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("type" IN ('weight_reps', 'bodyweight', 'timed')), "category" TEXT NULL CHECK("category" IN ('chest', 'back', 'legs', 'shoulders', 'arms', 'core', 'full_body', 'other')), "increment_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5 CHECK("increment_kg" > 0.0), "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rest_sec" >= 0), "include_in_strength_index" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("include_in_strength_index" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "step_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg' CHECK("step_mode" IN ('standard', 'kg', 'lbs', 'levels')), "increment_lbs" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 15.0 CHECK("increment_lbs" > 0.0), "level_kg" REAL NULL CHECK("level_kg" > 0.0), "timer_countdown" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("timer_countdown" IN (0, 1)), "rest_by_heart_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("rest_by_heart_rate" IN (0, 1)), "hr_target_range" INTEGER NULL CHECK("hr_target_range" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "hr_target_bpm" INTEGER NULL CHECK("hr_target_bpm" BETWEEN 40 AND 250), "hr_target_minutes" INTEGER NULL CHECK("hr_target_minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 180));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) > 0), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('superset', 'rotation')), "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rest_sec" >= 0), "rotation_every" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("rotation_every" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "rotation_exercise_id" INTEGER NULL, "rotation_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("rotation_done" >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_sets" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "target_reps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_reps" >= 1), "target_duration_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_duration_sec" >= 1), "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rest_sec" >= 0), "group_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES plan_groups (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, UNIQUE ("plan_id", "exercise_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_schedules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), "minute_of_day" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("minute_of_day" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "plan_name_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_supersets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rest_sec" >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_sets" >= 1), "target_reps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_reps" >= 1), "target_duration_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_duration_sec" >= 1), "rest_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rest_sec" >= 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('pending', 'active', 'done', 'skipped')), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "superset_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES session_supersets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "hr_avg" INTEGER NULL, "hr_max" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("session_id", "exercise_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "set_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "set_index" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("set_index" >= 1), "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("reps" >= 1), "duration_sec" INTEGER NULL CHECK("duration_sec" >= 1), "is_warmup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_warmup" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "hr_avg" INTEGER NULL, "hr_peak" INTEGER NULL, "hr_target_sec" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_weight_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("date") = 10) UNIQUE, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight_kg" > 0.0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "default_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3 CHECK("default_sets" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "default_rest_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 90 CHECK("default_rest_sec" >= 0), "rest_timer_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("rest_timer_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "vibration_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("vibration_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "keep_screen_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("keep_screen_on" IN (0, 1)), "auto_activate_next" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_activate_next" IN (0, 1)), "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system' CHECK("theme_mode" IN ('system', 'light', 'dark')), "last_selected_plan_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "last_backup_at" TEXT NULL, "backup_reminder_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 14 CHECK("backup_reminder_days" >= 0), "default_step" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 15.0 CHECK("default_step" > 0.0), "default_step_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lbs' CHECK("default_step_unit" IN ('kg', 'lbs')), "notify_evening" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify_evening" IN (0, 1)), "evening_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1200 CHECK("evening_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), "notify_before" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify_before" IN (0, 1)), "before_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60 CHECK("before_minutes" BETWEEN 5 AND 1440), "notify_rest" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify_rest" IN (0, 1)), "notify_open_session" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify_open_session" IN (0, 1)), "notify_backup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify_backup" IN (0, 1)), "notify_streak" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notify_streak" IN (0, 1)), "check_updates" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("check_updates" IN (0, 1)), "booking_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'https://optioffice.eu/optioffice/login/homepagemodul.php?s=2070&c=303161843&action=termin&t=19192&i=0', "last_update_check_at" TEXT NULL, "latest_version" TEXT NULL, "notifications_asked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("notifications_asked" IN (0, 1)), "hr_device_id" TEXT NULL, "hr_device_name" TEXT NULL, "hr_max" INTEGER NULL CHECK("hr_max" BETWEEN 100 AND 250), "birth_year" INTEGER NULL CHECK("birth_year" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2100), "sex" TEXT NULL CHECK("sex" IN ('male', 'female')), "hr_warn_bpm" INTEGER NULL CHECK("hr_warn_bpm" BETWEEN 60 AND 250), "hr_pause_bpm" INTEGER NULL CHECK("hr_pause_bpm" BETWEEN 40 AND 220), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "heart_rate_samples" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "bpm" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("bpm" BETWEEN 20 AND 255));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_heart_rates" ("session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "avg_bpm" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_bpm" INTEGER NOT NULL, "min_bpm" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "histogram" TEXT NOT NULL, "curve" TEXT NOT NULL, "recovery_bpm" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id"));
